title: Equilibrium Joining Strategies for Queues in Two-Phase Random Environment
summary: We study equilibrium joining strategies in an M/M/1-type queueing system with strategic customers operating in a two-phase random environment described as a continuous-time Markov process. Strategic customers, upon arrival, choose whether to join or to balk based on available information and anticipated utility, considering the trade-off between reward from service and waiting cost.
